# Horizontal scroll sync binds nothing when it registers before the DOM

## Context

`test/playwright/component/container/CardGridContainment.spec.mjs:181` fails in the components tier with "the center toolbar synchronizes to the scrollbar" (expected 141, received 0). It failed twice in a row on #21150: both arms on the first attempt, the Grid arm on the re-run. Other grid pull requests passed it today. Locally, on `dev` `56353531da`, it fails in most runs, so #21150 does not cause it.

## The Problem

A probe in that spec recorded, in the main thread:
- every `DomAccess.getElement` of the scrollbar's id;
- the scrollbar's insertion, through a MutationObserver;
- every `scroll` listener added to a horizontal scrollbar.

The runs differ only in order:

| Run | Scrollbar lookup | Scrollbar inserted | Listener added | Header after the scroll |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| failing | 286 ms, not in the document | 290 ms | never | stays at 0 for 5 s while the scrollbar sits at 141 |
| passing | 330 ms, found | 308 ms | 330 ms | follows within 52 ms |

In the failing run the registration exists, keyed to the live scrollbar's id. Calling the addon's `onScroll(registration, …)` by hand syncs the header at once, and it stays synced.

So the addon's `register()` can run in the main thread before the DOM insertion of the grid it belongs to. The call goes from the App worker to the main thread, while the DOM delta comes through the VDom worker. `register()` binds through `DomAccess.getElement(id)?.addEventListener`. A node not yet in the document gets no listener, and nothing binds it later. The scrollbar then moves alone: body, centre header, group row and follower rows stay put. If the view is missing too, its wheel never reaches the scrollbar.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/main/addon/GridHorizontalScrollSync.mjs`:
  - `register()` binds `scroll` on the scrollbar, `scroll` on the centre header and `wheel` on the view, each through an optional lookup (lines 145–148).
  - `unregister()` removes them from whatever nodes it finds then.
- `src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs`: `afterSetMounted(true)` calls `updateGridHorizontalScrollSyncAddon(true)`, which awaits `getAddon()` and then calls `addon.register()`.
- `src/main/addon/ScrollSync.mjs:77`, used by `Neo.grid.VerticalScrollbar`, binds the same way. It is not reproduced here.
- Design authority: the JSDoc of `register()`, "Binds a grid's scrollbar, centre header and wheel listeners, replacing an earlier registration of `id`." A registration that binds no listener contradicts it.

## The Fix

The addon listens once per document, in the capture phase, for `scroll` and `wheel`. It routes each event by its target's id (the scrollbar or the centre header), or for `wheel` by the registered view on the event's path. `register()` and `unregister()` only add and remove a registration's node ids. A registration made before its nodes exist, or one whose nodes are replaced, keeps working, since there is no per-node listener to bind or to lose.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.main.addon.GridHorizontalScrollSync#register` | its JSDoc | a registration syncs once its scrollbar, header and view exist, in either order of registration and insertion | none | JSDoc | unit; `CardGridContainment.spec.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A registration made before its scrollbar, header and view are in the document syncs the body, the header and the follower rows once they are, and the view's wheel moves the scrollbar (unit).
- [ ] `unregister()` ends the sync of its grid and leaves other registrations syncing (unit).
- [ ] `CardGridContainment.spec.mjs`'s two "gains horizontal scroll" arms pass 20 of 20 locally (`--repeat-each 10`), where `dev` fails most runs.
- [ ] The existing addon specs pass: `HorizontalScrollSyncFollowers`, `AddonTeardown`, `LockedColumns` and `HorizontalScrollbar`.

## Out of Scope

- `Neo.main.addon.ScrollSync`: the same binding pattern, but not reproduced. It gets its own ticket if a run shows it.
- The order between the App worker's addon calls and the VDom worker's deltas.

## Avoided Traps

- **Retrying the lookup on animation frames.** It covers this race, but not a node replaced later.
- **Registering from `ScrollManager` only after a paint signal.** That adds a second timing assumption in another thread.
